Meet Shobdo: a reading companion that gives you the Bangla and English meaning of any word, right where you read.
On any webpage, just double-click a word. You get its Bangla meaning, how common it is, English definitions, and the sentence you found it in.
Each word shows its family, like resilient and resilience. Click one, or double-click any word in the box, to look it up right there. The back arrow takes you back.
Select a phrase or a whole sentence, press Translate, and read it in Bangla instantly.
Want a second opinion? Open the sentence in Google Translate, or search a word on Google, in a small window right beside your page.
Or ask an AI to explain it. Pick ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek, and the question opens already typed. Choose which ones show in Settings.
Saved words follow you. Shobdo spots them on every page you visit, even in other forms, like intimidate and intimidation.
Found an article worth keeping? Save it to Shobdo with one click, and give it a short, clear name.
The saved copy opens in a clean reader, even offline. Highlight it, add notes, and see your words on the page.
PDFs open in Shobdo's own reader. Look up words the same way, and highlight lines in four colors.
Every document keeps its highlights and notes, plus a list of your words that appear in it.
Click the title to give any PDF a name that makes sense to you.
Your library keeps every saved word with its meaning and sentence. Turn on Recall mode to hide the meanings and test yourself.
Then run quick revision rounds, from all your words or just one page. Or fill in the missing word, in the sentence where you met it.
And Shobdo quietly tracks your reading time, so you can watch the habit grow.
